lastSession.summary: Implemented marky-zan: incremental tree-sitter parsing wired end-to-end. Added Parser::parse_with_old_tree() passing old MarkdownTree to tree-sitter for reuse. Wired InputEdit computation into ServerState::apply_document_changes with byte_to_point conversion. 3 new parser tests + 5 new state tests (correctness match, 100-edit stress). Added criterion benchmark. Discovery: tree-sitter-md dual block+inline grammar limits incremental speedup to ~1.3x at parse level. Full 10x+ requires Phase 3 (incremental indexing).
